elaine-cs: Heads-up — noticed playbook is suppressing ~230 trial accounts during onboarding because "confidence" flag is false in CRM sync. This looks like a data mapping regression from last Friday's connector change. Anyone else seeing spikes? :thinking:

sam-analytics: Hmm, saw a spike in 'suppressed_by_confidence' metric around 03/19 deploy. Can run quick slice to confirm whether it's false positives or actual low-quality leads.

maya-ops: Can you paste the query? I can run it in sandbox and tag sample accounts for manual review.

sam-analytics: Query:
```
SELECT account_id, onboarding_status, crm_confidence_score
FROM crm_accounts
WHERE suppressed_by_confidence = true
AND created_at > DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 30 DAY)
LIMIT 200;
```

sam-analytics: Early look: ~70% have non-empty email & >1 activity — suggests false suppression.

raj-eng: Ugh, that smells like the new connector defaulting 'crm_confidence' to null -> treated as low. The mapping change made missing mapping for source.email_verified. I'll patch mapping and deploy a backfill. ETA today.

elaine-cs: Awesome. For mitigation can we add a temporary playbook override for accounts with onboarding_status in ('started', 'contacted') so they don't get suppressed until backfill complete? Need to avoid churn.

playbook-bot: Suggested policy change created: playbook.override.confidence_safety = true (expires 2026-03-25T00:00:00Z) — awaiting approval from #customer-success-leads.

maya-ops: +1 from ops. @olivia-cs can you sign off so we can flip the override?

olivia-cs: Signed off. Please add a note to CS ops runbook and mark rollout in casebook.

sam-analytics: After mapping patch I'll run a recalibration job:
```
python scripts/recalc_healthscore.py --source=crm --filter='suppressed_by_confidence' --sample=1000
```
Should take ~45m.

raj-eng: Patch merged to staging. Backfill job scheduled at 2am UTC with throttling 50 qps. I'll monitor errors and rollback if error rate > 1%.

elaine-cs: Thanks team. After backfill let's snapshot healthscore distribution and compare pre/post. If we see >5 point swings for enterprise tier, we might need manual audit.

sam-analytics: Will produce a small dashboard and post link when ready.

olivia-cs: Also capture a short CSV of 50 random accounts that were re-enabled so AE team can confirm no spammy ones. Ops can DM the CSV once done.

maya-ops: On it. I'll also add a temporary Playbook note: 'confidence suppression - disabled during CRM mapping incident' with link to this thread.

elaine-cs: Good. Quick ask — can we add an automated smoke check to the nightly hygiene job to alert if suppression rate jumps >3x? That would catch this earlier next time.

raj-eng: Yep, I'll add a metric and wire a PagerDuty notify for prod-suppression-alerts.

playbook-bot: Action items created: [patch mapping, backfill, playbook override, recalibration dashboard, sample CSV, nightly-alert]. Assigned: raj-eng/sam-analytics/maya-ops/olivia-cs. ETA collective: 2026-03-24.

olivia-cs: Thanks. :thumbsup: 

elaine-cs: Closing loop — spun ticket CS-9871 for postmortem + runbook addendum. Will update once we validate post-backfill metrics.
